steps.title: The play designer
steps.text: This is the GridIronVault play designer. Let me show you around.

steps.title: Every tool, one panel
steps.text: Every tool sits in one panel. Draw, routes, players, sets, playbooks, and style.

steps.title: Open one. The rest fold.
steps.text: Open one section, and the rest fold away. No clutter.

steps.title: Drop your own sets
steps.text: Drop a formation from your own sets, right on the ball.

steps.title: Routes in one click
steps.text: Click a receiver, pick a route, and it draws at real depth, in his color.

steps.title: Tap to block
steps.text: Tap a lineman, tap the defender, and the block is drawn.

steps.title: Slide the line
steps.text: Slide the line of scrimmage, and the whole play moves with it.

steps.title: Menus up top
steps.text: Edit, Field, Teach, and Go to, right up top. Undo is always one click away.

steps.title: Draw it fast. Draw it right.
steps.text: Draw it fast. Draw it right.

steps.title: Draw once. Wear it.
steps.text: Draw the routes once. Wear them on game day.

steps.title: One click, real depth
steps.text: Click a receiver, pick a route. One click, real depth.

steps.title: Into the playbook
steps.text: Save it, and the play lands in your playbook.

steps.title: Cards build themselves
steps.text: Open Wristbands, pick the playbook, and the cards build themselves.

steps.title: Same size, every box
steps.text: Same size in every box, numbered the way you call them.

steps.title: Preview what prints
steps.text: Preview exactly what prints, then download the PDF.

steps.title: Designer to wrist
steps.text: From the designer to the wrist.

steps.title: Routes in one click
steps.text: Routes in one click. Here's how.

steps.title: Click. Pick. Done.
steps.text: Click the receiver. Pick the route. Slant, three yards. Done.

steps.title: Flip the break
steps.text: Flip the break, or change the line end, right there.

steps.title: Tap to block
steps.text: Linemen? Tap him, tap the defender, and he blocks.

steps.title: Centers run routes
steps.text: In 5-on-5 and 7-on-7, your center runs routes too.

steps.title: Less clicking. More coaching.
steps.text: Less clicking. More coaching.

steps.title: Will it beat Cover 3?
steps.text: Will it beat Cover 3? Find out before Saturday.

steps.title: Run the Coverage check
steps.text: Open Teach, and run the Coverage check.

steps.title: Green means it wins
steps.text: Every look gets a grade. Green means it wins.

steps.title: Open. Tight. Covered.
steps.text: See who's open, who's tight, and who's covered.

steps.title: Build the call sheet
steps.text: Then build your call sheet from the plays that win.

steps.title: Know it works. Then call it.
steps.text: Know it works, before you call it.

steps.title: Draw it clean
steps.text: Clean plays read faster. Here's how to draw them clean.

steps.title: Snap to the grid
steps.text: Open Field controls. Snap to the grid, and every player lines up.

steps.title: Hash marks & yard lines
steps.text: Pick your hash marks, and turn the yard lines up or down.

steps.title: Right click any route
steps.text: Right click any route to change the line, the weight, the color, or the end.

steps.title: Route depths
steps.text: Turn on route depths, and every break shows its yards.

steps.title: Sharp on the wristband
steps.text: Sharp on the screen. Sharp on the wristband.

steps.title: Bring your plays
steps.text: Got plays on a whiteboard, or in a binder? Bring them with you.

steps.title: Photo, scan or PDF
steps.text: Open Upload, and drop in a photo, a scan, or a PDF.

steps.title: It reads the play
steps.text: GridIronVault reads the players, the routes, and the blocks.

steps.title: Check the read
steps.text: Check the read, and fix anything with a click.

steps.title: A real play
steps.text: Save it, and it's a real play you can edit, teach, and print.

steps.title: Old playbook. New Vault.
steps.text: Your old playbook, in your new Vault.

steps.title: Meet Griddy
steps.text: Meet Griddy, your coaching assistant. He's on every page.

steps.title: Ask, and he draws
steps.text: Ask for a play in plain words, and he draws it.

steps.title: Save to the Vault
steps.text: Like it? Save it straight to your Vault.

steps.title: Recolor a playbook
steps.text: Tell him to recolor a whole playbook, and it's done. Undo is one click.

steps.title: Build a call sheet
steps.text: He'll even build a call sheet from the plays you already have.

steps.title: Just ask Griddy
steps.text: Got a question? Just ask Griddy.

steps.title: Line up faster
steps.text: Line up faster. Formations and defenses are one click away.

steps.title: Drop a formation
steps.text: Open Sets, pick a formation, and drop it on the ball.

steps.title: Flip it
steps.text: Flip it left or right with one switch.

steps.title: Front & coverage
steps.text: Need a look to beat? Pick a front and a coverage, and every defender gets a job.

steps.title: Offense to defense
steps.text: Or turn your offense into a defense, matched to the formation.

steps.title: Set it. Flip it. Coach it.
steps.text: Set it. Flip it. Coach it.

steps.title: Your call sheet
steps.text: Game day runs on your call sheet. Build it right here.

steps.title: Type. It links.
steps.text: Type a play name, and it links to the play in your Vault.

steps.title: Paint & add columns
steps.text: Paint your calls by situation, and add any column you need.

steps.title: Find & fold
steps.text: Find a call in a second, or fold away what you don't need.

steps.title: Print & wristbands
steps.text: Then print the sheet, and send the same calls to your wristbands.

steps.title: One sheet. Every call.
steps.text: One sheet. Every call.

steps.title: Planned to the minute
steps.text: A good practice is planned to the minute.

steps.title: Timed periods
steps.text: Build your script in timed periods, and watch the clock add up.

steps.title: Plays from your Vault
steps.text: Drop in plays from your Vault, one at a time, or a whole playbook.

steps.title: The Drill Vault
steps.text: Open the Drill Vault for animated drills with coaching points.

steps.title: Drill to practice
steps.text: Add a drill to tonight's practice, right from the Drill Vault.

steps.title: Print the script
steps.text: Then print the script, and the scout cards.

steps.title: Your team
steps.text: Your roster, your depth chart, and your colors, all in one place.

steps.title: Import the roster
steps.text: Import your roster from a spreadsheet, parents and all.

steps.title: Depth chart on the field
steps.text: Set your depth chart right on the field.

steps.title: Logo & colors
steps.text: Add your logo and colors, and they show up on the field, the wristbands, and the PDFs.

steps.title: Text the team
steps.text: Then text the whole team from your own phone.

steps.title: Your team. Your Vault.
steps.text: Your team. Your Vault.

steps.title: Players know it
steps.text: A playbook only works if your players know it.

steps.title: Build the playbook
steps.text: Group your plays into a playbook, in the order you install them.

steps.title: Share one link
steps.text: Share it with one link. No account, and no app to download.

steps.title: Their own job
steps.text: Each player picks a letter, and sees their own job on every play.

steps.title: The Griddy Quiz
steps.text: Then the Griddy Quiz shows you who really knows it.

steps.title: Teach it once
steps.text: Teach it once. Let them study all week.

steps.title: Twelve cameras
steps.text: Teach any play in the Film Room, now from twelve different cameras.

steps.title: Behind the offense
steps.text: Start behind the offense, and watch the whole play unfold.

steps.title: Quarterback cam
steps.text: Jump to the quarterback cam, and ride with him to the throw.

steps.title: Wide. Sideline. Overhead.
steps.text: Go wide, high above the end zone, to the sideline, or straight overhead.

steps.title: Follow a player
steps.text: Follow any one player, or look through his helmet.

steps.title: One play. Twelve ways.
steps.text: One play. Twelve ways to teach it.
